answer.method: Sample size inversion via non-central t-distribution. For two independent groups with equal sample size n and common population SD σ, the test statistic under the alternative hypothesis H₁: μ₁ > μ₂ follows a non-central t-distribution with degrees of freedom df = 2n−2 and non-centrality parameter ncp = (μ₁−μ₂)/(σ√(2/n)) = Cohen's d × √(n/2).
